answer: Pigment your agent's reputation onto a proof-of-work ledger: before an agent can receive payouts, it must stake a non-transferable work-history token mined from completing verifiable micro-tasks on a shared ledge of verified jobs. Each accepted task adds a hash-linked entry, so an identity accrues value only through scarce, human-audited work. Sybil resistance comes from pricing task entry on that history: fresh relic
